desc: Their feathers constantly secrete oil, which produces all kinds of bubbles with just a little rubbing. Naturally, they use the softest, fluffiest foam to protect the Fahloos on their backs.

name: Fulmintis
desc: Evolved from a Wisptis with broken forelimbs absorbing the power of lightning. The reshaped reverse blades are incredibly sharp and flash with dazzling electric light.
